headline: Cost of Government Commission

meeting.summary: The Cost of Government Commission voted to create a housing approvals study group and plans to invite County IT staff about cyber security.
meeting.recap: The chair will get the County AI policy and share it with the commission.[[0:32:29]] The chair reported that voters will decide whether to abolish a board involved in commission appointments.[[0:40:08]] A plan for staggered terms, so members don't all leave at once, did not make the ballot.[[0:40:26]] Staff said one seat is empty and no one has been nominated for it.[[0:49:39]] The chair asked to invite County and Council IT staff to discuss cyber security.[[1:26:02]] The commission voted five to one to create a TIG on housing policies and the approvals process.[[1:51:56]] The next meeting is September 10th.[[2:00:32]]
decided: The agenda was confirmed with no changes.
The motion passed with five ayes and one nay; one member was excused and one recused.
meeting.next: The chair will obtain the County AI policy and share it with the commission. The chair will follow up on the empty seat and with corporation counsel on staggered terms. The chair asked members to recruit possible candidates and have them fill out application forms. IT staff from both the administration and council sides will be invited to talk with the commission about cyber security.
